title: Public sector modernization is real in places, but cyber staffing recommendations are still not being followed
content_md:
The truth is that there is an effort under way in the public sector to modernize public administration, and in several areas it is going well. However, the recommendations produced by the cyber security authority on staffing and organization are still not being implemented at most agencies, so the gap between published guidance and actual defensive capacity remains wide.
